reviews.comment: [Sample] A joint definitions workshop with sign-off from each department addresses the real cause.
“Train users” is generic and doesn’t stop teams keeping their own spreadsheets.
reviews.suggestion: Retire the old spreadsheets on a set date and make the new reports the only source for the monthly review.

reviews.comment: Briefing a deputy helps, but there’s no trigger for when they take over.
reviews.suggestion: Name a co-sponsor now and have both sign off at each phase gate.

reviews.comment: A contingency is sensible, but no amount or approval route is given.
reviews.suggestion: Hold 10% contingency released only by the steering group.

overall: [Sample] Your mitigation for the biggest risk is strong, but adoption – the other high-high risk – is barely covered. Strengthen that before presenting the plan.
